intervals.label: proposed experiment with a dedicated cryostat at LSM
intervals.note: Proposed, not approved by a source read: the Modane host proposal is documented (Nucl. Phys. B 2024; TAUP 2025 slides titled 'Proposed experiment at LSM'). Start is the beginning of the discussions about hosting at LSM ('early 2022'); the US-based TESSERACT R&D is older.
intervals.quote: Since early 2022, the French CNRS-IN2P3 laboratories IP2I, LPSC, and IJCLab are discussing with the USA-based TESSERACT collaboration in order to 1) install a dedicated cryostat for TESSERACT at the underground Modane Laboratory (LSM)

intervals.label: planned installation of the two TESSERACT setups at LSM
intervals.note: A schedule, not a report. Earlier schedules were earlier (NPB 2024: first searches 2026; LBNL 2025: construction from 2025, online ~2029); the most recent sources (Oct 2025, June 2026) say 2028.
intervals.quote: The two setups will be in LSM between 2027 and 2028

intervals.label: planned full integration of the TESSERACT setup at LSM
intervals.note: June 2026 abstract; a plan, not a report.
intervals.quote: Full integration of the TESSERACT setup at the Modane Underground Laboratory (LSM) is planned for 2028.

placements.note: Proposed installation at LSM (Nucl. Phys. B names the former EDELWEISS-III experimental space). The first result came from a surface prototype in the sub-basement of Birge Hall, UC Berkeley, which is not an Atlas site.
placements.quote: Since early 2022, the French CNRS-IN2P3 laboratories IP2I, LPSC, and IJCLab are discussing with the USA-based TESSERACT collaboration in order to 1) install a dedicated cryostat for TESSERACT at the underground Modane Laboratory (LSM)

description.quote: SPICE aims at developing an array of 1 cm3 Al2O3 and SiO2 detectors, instrumented on one face with athermal phonon sensors
description.value: Polar (Al2O3, SiO2) and scintillating (GaAs) crystal detectors read out with athermal-phonon TES sensors, for electromagnetically coupled dark matter

description.quote: The experiment consists of a superfluid helium target where DM particles would undergo nuclear recoil interactions.
description.value: Superfluid helium-4 target read out by TES calorimeters detecting scintillation and evaporated helium atoms (quantum evaporation)

description.note: Quote reproduces the extracted text of the PDF ('Frenchbased': the hyphen is lost in extraction).
description.quote: add a third Frenchbased cryogenic semiconducting (Ge, Si) detector technology to the TESSERACT payload
description.value: Proposed French cryogenic germanium (and silicon) bolometers with heat and ionization readout, adding a third technology to the payload

summary.plain: The planned TESSERACT payload: several small cryogenic detectors (crystals and superfluid helium) read out by superconducting transition-edge sensors, sitting inside one shielded cryostat at Modane.
summary.technical: Proposed LSM setup: central cryostat in nested shielding (outer HDPE neutron shield, lead, inner polyethylene, mu-metal), ISO-6 clean room and radon suppression, in the former EDELWEISS-III area; payload of SPICE, HeRALD and Ge/Si modules sharing TES phonon readout; two similar cryostats are envisioned.

technology.quote: The TESSERACT experiment will deploy 3 unique detector modules based on a common transition edge sensor-based readout to search for sub-GeV dark matter.
technology.value: Multi-target cryogenic detectors read out by transition-edge-sensor athermal-phonon sensors
